Product Details: The DongCheng DCPB488 Cordless Brushless Impact Wrench is a powerful and compact tool built for demanding professional and DIY applications. Delivering an impressive 488 N·m of maximum torque, it effortlessly handles heavy-duty bolt tightening and loosening tasks across automotive repair, scaffolding installation, steel structure work, and machine maintenance. Powered by a 20V MAX brushless motor, it offers greater efficiency, longer runtime, and extended motor life compared to conventional brushed motors. The 3-speed control (Low: 0–1200 r/min, Medium: 0–1900 r/min, High: 0–2400 r/min) allows precise adjustment for a wide range of applications. The smart-locking mode automatically stops the tool in reverse rotation once the nut or bolt is loose, ensuring safer and more controlled operation. The 1/2" (12.7 mm) square drive enables quick and easy socket changes, while the aluminium gear housing ensures durability and long-lasting performance. A built-in LED work light illuminates dark work areas. The 4.0Ah lithium-ion battery with a battery level indicator provides extended work time. The compact body (175 mm x 205 mm) and ergonomic design reduce user fatigue. Includes 2 batteries, 1 charger, 1 socket (22 mm), 1 belt clip, and 1 carry case.
